title: Engram project settings: derive Save & enable's disabled state from its unavailable reason, and polish the turned-off copy
outcome: In ui/src/EngramProjectSettingsPanel.tsx, Save & enable's disabled state is derived from describeSaveUnavailableReason (saveDisabled = reason !== null), so a disabled button always has a reason and an enabled one never does. The turned-off guidance, the Save reason and the footer sentence no longer repeat one another. The failed-Verify reason does not point at "errors above" when none are listed.
acceptance: Engram project settings: derive Save & enable's disabled state from its unavailable reason, and polish the turned-off copy is done
